# groundcover OTEL CI/CD Export Action

This repository contains a GitHub Action that exports GitHub Actions workflow runs as OpenTelemetry traces to groundcover.

## Canonical files

- `action.yml`: canonical input and output contract
- `README.md`: usage, permissions, examples, and operational guidance
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`: contributor workflow and verification requirements

## groundcover usage rules

- Use a workspace-specific OTLP endpoint provided by groundcover via `groundcoverEndpoint`.
- Do not hardcode a specific OTLP endpoint URL.
- Do not include `/v1/traces` in `groundcoverEndpoint` — the exporter appends it automatically.
- Pass the groundcover ingestion key via `apiKey`.
- See `https://docs.groundcover.com/integrations/data-sources/opentelemetry/sending-from-an-opentelemetry-collector` for endpoint setup.
- See `https://docs.groundcover.com/use-groundcover/remote-access-and-apis/ingestion-keys` for ingestion key creation.

## Per-test spans from report artifacts

- `testResultsArtifactPrefix` (e.g. `test-reports-`) names the workflow-run artifacts holding JUnit XML. Matching artifacts are downloaded and parsed; without it, no per-test spans are produced.
- Artifact naming is a contract: `<prefix><sanitized job name>`, where the sanitized job name is the job's display name — the part after the last `" / "` for reusable workflows — with every run of characters outside `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]` replaced by `-`. Upload with `overwrite: true` so a rerun replaces the previous attempt's reports.
- Span hierarchy: `workflow run` → `job` → `Tests / <suite or file name>` (one wrapper per JUnit file) → one span per test case.
- The wrapper span is named after the file's single suite, or the file name when the file holds several suites, and carries that file's rollup: `test.report`, `test.suites`, `test.total`, `test.passed`, `test.failed`, `test.skipped`, `test.errors`, `test.duration`. The workflow root keeps the run-wide rollup.
- Wrapper timing copies the job: `started_at` → `max(started_at, completed_at)`.
- Test start time is the job start time — JUnit carries durations but no per-test timestamps, so test spans are anchored at the job start and their durations are exact. Overlapping test spans are expected.
- Test case attributes: `test.name`, `test.classname`, `test.suite`, `test.status`, `test.duration_ms`, `test.leaf` (false for subtest ancestors), `test.collateral` (zero-duration failure with no output, i.e. a framework abort), `test.failure.message`.
- Failed and errored cases are error spans and additionally emit a log record, correlated with the test's span, carrying the failure message and captured `system-out`. Passing-test output is not exported. These log records are sent even when `exportLogs` is `false`.

## Supported behavior

- Export workflow runs, jobs, and steps as nested spans.
- Export per-test spans from JUnit XML report artifacts via `testResultsArtifactPrefix`.
- By default, export GitHub Actions job logs as OpenTelemetry log records correlated with job and step spans (`exportLogs` defaults to `true`). Set `exportLogs: false` to disable.
- Support `traceparent` to link CI/CD traces with application traces.
- Support same-workflow export and separate `workflow_run` export.
- For separate workflow trace linking, persist the `traceparent` in the source workflow and pass it into the export workflow.
- Always set resource attribute `source=github-actions`.
- Support configurable `workload` and optional `env` resource attributes.
- By default, upsert a PR comment with a groundcover traces link filtered by PR number (`commentOnPr` defaults to `true`).
- PR commenting requires `issues: write` permission. Always include it in workflow permissions.

## Implementation rules

- Keep the runtime on Node 20.
- Keep TypeScript strict mode enabled.
- Never log secrets.
- Mask sensitive OTLP headers with `core.setSecret()`.
- Preserve committed bundle output in `dist/`.
- After changes, run `npm run all`.

## Useful paths

- `src/runner.ts`: action orchestration
- `src/tracer.ts`: OTLP exporter setup and `traceparent` extraction
- `src/trace/workflow.ts`: workflow root span generation
- `src/trace/job.ts`: job span generation
- `src/trace/step.ts`: step span generation
- `src/github.ts`: GitHub API interactions (workflow runs, jobs, logs, annotations)
